name: Rogue Synthetic
description: A service Synthetic with its owner insignia scraped off and its casing patched by its own hands.
role: The look of the Rogue Synthetic, a machine that claimed its own name.

artBrief.spriteScale: A character of a 2×2 cell footprint.
requiredVariants: 8 directions, each with idle and walk frames (the Object Layer direction set)
artBrief.silhouette: Upright synthetic frame with a narrow visor.
artBrief.detail: Off-white service casing with a scraped insignia and mismatched repair plates.
artBrief.paletteDirection: Off-white casing, rust-orange repairs, a dark visor with one amber light.
